paragraphs.text: Hellion is a mainly red creature type used for cards that depict enormous, wormlike creatures with scaly, snakelike bodies, spiky knobs along their sides, and a ring of tentacles surrounding a toothy maw, the danger of which is usually superseded by the fact that hellion maws are often glowing. Hellions are unique to Magic in this depiction, with the closest real-life inspiration being supersized dobsonfly larvae (also known as hellgrammites) given a mouth like a lamprey eel or leech.
Hellions are manifestations of nature's blind rage. Most are huge, about the size of freight trains. They are mighty, unpredictable, and hostile. Often, the Hellion is the beating heart of a volcano.
Mechanically, they are rather large (typically above four power) and have devour , haste, damage dealing, or damage amplifying.

The first creature to bear the type was Volcano Hellion in Planar Chaos , though the Crater Hellion from Urza's Saga , the Flowstone Hellion from Stronghold and the Iron-Barb Hellion from Fifth Dawn were all issued errata to become Hellions as well as Beasts . At the time of the Grand Creature Type Update , R&D talked about consolidating Hellion into another creature type, but after many days arguing about how to consolidate it, they left it alone.
Hellions can be found on the following planes :
Ulasht , a Hellion-Headed Hydra . The Hellion type was added later.
